title: Ship the operator-questions skill
description: Add skills/operator-questions/SKILL.md and its supporting files, per the design in opum-doc docs/reference/operator-questions-skill-design.md at opum-doc origin/main 1312f0c, section Changes this needs in plain-english-styles item 1. The skill shapes one A/B/C operator question sized to the active Plain English level, and files and records it in Quest and Lore. Shape and level table first; SKILL.md under 500 lines; supporting files levels.md, diagrams.md and quest-and-lore.md; description and when_to_use under 1536 characters together.

acceptanceCriteria.text: skills/operator-questions/SKILL.md exists and is under 500 lines
The skill description and when_to_use together are under 1536 characters
Supporting files levels.md, diagrams.md and quest-and-lore.md exist under skills/operator-questions/
The skill description leads with the trigger Use when you need the operator to decide something
The skill obeys the active style level limits and names no second different word cap

finalSummary:
Ships the operator-questions skill: skills/operator-questions/ with SKILL.md (125 lines), levels.md, diagrams.md and quest-and-lore.md, per opum-doc docs/reference/operator-questions-skill-design.md at opum-doc origin/main 1312f0c item 1. PR opum-ai/plain-english-styles#47, merged at head f9cddd1 (squash 7f66e54). Gates on f9cddd1: claude plugin validate exit 0; claude plugin test 21/21; npm --prefix harness test 245/245; harness contract audit exit 0 with all 12 checks agreeing.

Criterion evidence: SKILL.md is 125 lines, under the 500 cap; the frontmatter description is 342 characters, under the 1536 combined limit, and leads with the trigger; the three supporting files exist; the contract audit exits 0, so no second word cap is named.

One deviation: the design names a companion when_to_use frontmatter field. It was omitted because that field is deprecated. Exact source of that claim: the skill-reviewer agent of the plugin-dev plugin, from the claude-plugins-official marketplace (publisher Anthropic), file /Users/jdnewhouse/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/claude-plugins-official/plugins/plugin-dev/agents/skill-reviewer.md, sha256 78ac55ddc31dd78227df90029d9c2333bdd97567296ddd4a9b23c090a94fc09a, line 57, verbatim: Optional fields: version, when_to_use (note: deprecated, use description only). The plugin declares no version field, so the file and its hash identify it. The trigger lives in description alone. Passed to opum-doc for the record.
